description: Given a list of integers nums with at least two elements and an integer target, where at least one pair of positions i < j satisfies nums[i] + nums[j] = target, return the pair (i, j) of 0-based indices with i < j and nums[i] + nums[j] = target that comes first lexicographically: i is as small as possible, and for that i, j is as small as possible.
